accepted.name: TCPL / Dawn Hunting
accepted.reason: Fictional firearms include the Corrupted Disaster Soldier with two firing modes and unusually elaborate projectile presentation. This is CQ1cz's separate fan-created gunpack, not the EMX runtime or an official Frontline product.
accepted.access: Creator forum account required for the listed download
accepted.note: The creator links the public TCPL resource page and Afdian channel. The forum lists version 26.3.31 and requires login to download. Current pricing, exact ZIP contents and Minecraft/loader pairing are not independently established. The separate Otherworld skin pack and EMX modification listing are not folded into this family.

accepted.name: RSCA / Redstone Arsenal
accepted.reason: An attachment-heavy project that also contains the distinct IMC-7274 firearm. The creator separately lists ten underbarrel accessories and thirteen sights, which are not miscounted as additional guns.
accepted.access: Creator states every version, including tests, is free
accepted.note: SF-2403 and Redstone Company are credited. The original release post explicitly lists IMC-7274 as a special-purpose gun and directs download acquisition through pinned comments. Exact current file, Minecraft version and loader remain unconfirmed. Scope is the actual additional firearm, not a recommendation for attachment-only content.

accepted.name: EMI Classic / Classics Unreforged
accepted.reason: Recreates an older Minecraft 1.7.10 Flan's Mod EMI arsenal inside TaCZ. Its intentionally nostalgic models and survival adaptation provide a different design reference from the modern EMX pack.
accepted.access: Creator states every version, including tests, is free
accepted.note: SF-2403 explicitly distinguishes this from EMX, credits a separate original model author, and says major model modernization is not its goal. The 1.7.10 reference describes the historical source mod, not the TaCZ compatibility version. No exact current TaCZ ZIP or Minecraft/loader pair was independently retrieved.

accepted.name: T.R.O.L / TROL
accepted.releaseLabel: Creator preview labels v2.1; later 2026 AK showcase
accepted.reason: Transforming guns, a biological Death Touch weapon, a twin-barrel flywheel steam rifle, crystal weapons and an electromagnetic AK upgrade line make this a particularly strong source for unusual AoA weapon concepts.
accepted.access: Creator-published public beta download; newer file access unconfirmed
accepted.note: The original beta0.1 announcement supplies a public share and names three firearms plus appearance-changing variant attachments. Later creator posts show A1.10, a steam-rifle preview visibly labeled v2.1, and additional weapons in 2026, but the old download is not relabeled as that newer edition. Earlier Cold Wind/Winter Is Coming/Biting Cold names are retained as lineage, not counted as separate current packs. No exact latest Minecraft/loader pair is inferred.

accepted.name: bare / Empty Pack
accepted.reason: A small independent firearm collection with its own public gun ZIP and a dedicated multi-minute gun-content showcase. It is separate from the creator's companion grenade pack.
accepted.note: The named firearm file is bare_gun_pack_converted.zip. The separately offered banger.zip is a grenade pack requiring LR Tactical Workshop; that grenade dependency is not automatically assigned to the gunpack. The creator acknowledges rough edges. Public download provenance is verified, not native runtime compatibility or the contents of the binary.

accepted.name: COD Collector's Edition / IFCD
accepted.releaseLabel: Creator-renamed IFCD family; TaCZ 1.1.6+ stated for newer showcases
accepted.reason: Creator-made game-inspired firearm models include Peacekeeper MK1, KRIG-6 and AK117 with elaborate geometry and animation. The IFCD-to-COD Collector's Edition rename is preserved as one family rather than duplicate recommendations.
accepted.access: Creator directs distribution through the pinned profile post
accepted.note: The creator explicitly renamed IFCD to COD Collector's Edition in the Peacekeeper MK1 announcement. Newer posts state TaCZ 1.1.6+, while older IFCD pieces have different requirements. Cosmetic variants of existing models are not counted as separate guns or packs. Current file, payment terms and Minecraft/loader pairing remain unconfirmed.
accepted.runtimeRequirement: Newer creator showcases: TaCZ 1.1.6+; older entries differ

accepted.name: Boonie Bears Weapons / Remake Test
accepted.reason: A cartoon-inspired weapon collection with an openly shared remake test and creator demonstrations of materials and handling. Firearm references are kept distinct from the included chainsaw/melee content.
accepted.access: Creator open test with public share
accepted.note: The release title specifies TaCZ 1.1.8 plus Gunsmith. It is an open test, not a verified stable release. The second video segment compares chainsaw animations and is not counted as additional gun content. The exact Minecraft/loader pair remains unconfirmed; the older preview referenced LR separately.

Public release exists, but a separate new firearm identity is not established. Preserve it as a promising visual-design lead, not a new TaCZ gun family.
